page.overview:
Who is Synapse?

Axel Soma was a Darklonian oligarch from a storied family who pioneered cybernetic technology paired with weapons development. His wealth and prestige came under scrutiny as Destro and Darklon consolidated their power in preparation for their invasion of neighboring European countries. Frustrated by his own diminished role, Soma secretly supplied the partisan resistance with arms and communications technology. Mistress Armada's spies, however, uncovered his disloyalty, and she personally led the violent assault upon his family's mansion on Destro's orders. Left for dead, alongside his family. and horribly disfigured, Synapse pulled himself out of the rubble and vowed revenge on Destro and all his subordinates. Essentially resurrecting himself, he's allied with Cobra Commander, offering his services as a developer and supplier. With his mindspike and synaptic claw, he is capable of hacking into the neural networks of nearby soldiers or even corpses, possessing them to create fodder for Cobra's ranks as well as emitting an electromagnetic pulse that disables nearby electronics. A man with no boundaries, Synapse will use whatever methods necessary to get his retribution, even if that means raising the dead to crush the living.
